To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) overfitting and attribute influence are necessary and sufficient conditions for membership and attribute inference attacks, respectively; and 2) membership inference and attribute influence are connected in such a way that membership inference is a necessary condition for attribute inference.

(1) overfitting is a key factor in privacy risk for machine learning algorithms, (2) influence on the target attribute is a critical factor for attribute inference attacks, and (3) the privacy risk from membership and attribute inference are deeply related, and membership inference attacks can be used to improve the effectiveness of attribute inference attacks.
1) Overfitting is necessary and sufficient for membership inference and, under certain conditions, attribute inference.
